messages.subject: Neovim 0.1.0 released
messages.body_plain:
Hello!

Neovim 0.1.0, Nvim-R 0.9.0, and nvimcom 0.9-8 were released!

Neovim is simpler to configure for Nvim-R than Vim is for Vim-R-plugin. The links to get the software:

Stable:
https://github.com/neovim/neovim/releases
http://www.lepem.ufc.br/jaa/NvimR.html
http://www.lepem.ufc.br/jaa/nvimcom.html

Development:
https://github.com/jalvesaq/Nvim-R
https://github.com/jalvesaq/nvimcom
https://github.com/neovim/neovim
Note: After starting nvim for the first time, read the section "Transitioning from Vim":
     :h nvim-from-vim

messages.subject: Vim-R-plugin 1.2.7 released
